guide.title: Beginner Tips
tips: Focus on early slimes first and upgrade them.
Do not waste boosts on low odds slimes.
Keep rolling consistently to increase chances.
Use crafting early to speed up progression.

guide.title: Luck Strategy
tips: Always stack multiple boosts before rolling.
Use boosts only during long roll sessions.
Save boosts for high rarity targets.
Play during events to maximize luck bonuses.

guide.title: Progress Faster
tips: Upgrade roll speed as soon as possible.
Focus on mid-tier slimes before chasing rare ones.
Use crafting to skip early grind.
Farm high-value slimes for faster currency.

guide.title: Advanced Strategy
tips: Track your rolls and compare with probability.
Target slimes with best value-to-odds ratio.
Avoid chasing ultra rare slimes too early.
